title: Prompt Architect — Flux
footerNote: Fictional adults only · not affiliated with Black Forest Labs
contentNote: All characters are fictional adults. No real people's likenesses.
subjectPlaceholder: What the subject is doing, as a sentence. Example: She sits on the edge of the bed and looks back over her shoulder.
cameraPlaceholder: Framing, lens, and angle. Example: Medium shot, eye level, 50mm lens, subject on the left third.
sequencePlaceholder: The action shared by every still. Each still adds its own beat and repeats the character sheet.

sequenceNotes.title: Same person
sequenceNotes.text: The identity line is copied into every still without rewriting it.

sequenceNotes.title: One beat each
sequenceNotes.text: Establish, closer, crest, and after are four separate images, not a cut list inside one prompt.

sequenceNotes.title: Sentences
sequenceNotes.text: Each still is prose: subject, setting, camera, lighting, then style.

principles.title: Subject first
principles.text: The identity line and the action lead. Setting, camera, lighting, and style follow.

principles.title: Sentences
principles.text: Write the way you would describe a photograph. Skip quality-tag piles and 8K spam.

principles.title: Character sheet
principles.text: Face, body, hair, wardrobe, setting, and lighting are inserted verbatim on every still.

principles.title: Negatives
principles.text: Leave the negative empty unless the workflow really uses CFG above 1. At CFG 1 it is ignored.

principles.title: People
principles.text: Fictional adults only. Do not describe a real person's likeness.

sources.title: How this app prompts Flux and LTX
